objective: Host PolyHamster as a static site on IPFS under the label polyhamster. The repository is a Next.js 15 app with output: 'export'. Build with `npm ci && npm run build`; the static export is the `out/` folder. Do not change any code or content: host it as it is. PolyHamster is a play-points prediction market (no real money, no token) on Squeektoshi, the hamster mining Squeekchain. At runtime the browser reads the public API https://api.squeekchain.com and calls RPC functions on a Supabase project; its URL and publishable key in lib/config.ts are public on purpose.
